what: The org-wide index of every surface. PUBLIC, so any repo can read it — a repo-scoped token cannot read a private one. This is the thing that gets passed around.
rule: A spoke is a door, not a second of capacity. Every spoke carries the argument for its own name, because a name that cannot argue does not get a door.
single_source: There is no second copy of this file. CI sweeps FROM here. If a route is not in this list it does not exist.

spokes.name: Horos
spokes.argument: the boundary stone. The index names itself, and the estate reads from it

spokes.name: Lethe
spokes.argument: forgetting, permitted. Nothing here binds and removal is free — the only room where being wrong is free

spokes.name: Ananke
spokes.argument: necessity. Four fields or no crossing. Highway 61 and 49 — where a thing becomes irreversible

spokes.name: Hestia
spokes.argument: the hearth. The private annex: PROFILE, POLITY, CIVICS, ESCALATION. Never leaves the house

spokes.name: Kophinos
spokes.argument: the basket. The corps, the curia, the coin of each legate, and the astrometry

spokes.name: Hermeneus
spokes.argument: the interpreter. 88 handles reduced to root, every uncertainty declared

spokes.name: Kopros
spokes.argument: what is carried. Failed conflict arrest: the bucket, the token, the ten cases

spokes.name: Krisis
spokes.argument: the judging. Ten checks, three of them disqualifying, and one assessment already REFUSED

spokes.name: Tekton
spokes.argument: the builder. Staged for review — Jena recommended, Camel deferred, three components refused with reasons

spokes.name: Metron
spokes.argument: the measure. Counts, manifests, coverage. Must not hold EXECUTE

spokes.name: Elenchos
spokes.argument: the cross-examination. Neighbour's raisings only. Must not hold RAISE

spokes.name: Mnema
spokes.argument: the memorial. Append-only, convenes the meeting, holds no price. Must not hold DELETE

spokes.name: Iris
spokes.argument: the rainbow. Carries between and never stays. Must not publish anything about a person

spokes.name: Fides
spokes.argument: good faith. Holds the treaty, does not sign it. Must not hold ACCEPTANCE

spokes.name: Minerva
spokes.argument: without envy. Grades, declines, downgrades freely — and may never upgrade without going and looking

route.why: An addition costs an argument. A removal costs nothing, and skips both rooms. A gate on deletion is a gate that guarantees growth.

reach.mechanism: each repo PULLS from doctrine on its own token. Nothing holds org-wide write.
reach.note: The push-based broadcast exists and cannot run: BROADCAST_TOKEN is unset and the default token cannot enumerate the org.

arithmetic.note: 15 = 3 x 5. The province has no factor of 3, so 3 is unpayable from it and 5 strand. Reported, never distributed. At 24 spokes the remainder was 8.
arithmetic.throughput: A spoke is a door, not a second of capacity. One container at 500 req/s serves 50,000,000 once in 27.8 hours, and adding spokes does not change that.

items: 135 repos with no lane — 36 forks, 35 reporting size:0 and unchecked, the rest unopened
grease — the pass-through rate is 66% and no spoke measures it
